title: 第五章九龙搬血
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
叶凡强压下心头因九龙搬血四个字泛起的炽热，没有半点拖泥带水，直接伸手入怀。

    他摸出那个装药的布袋，数出十颗泛着微光的凝气丹。

    药丸在粗布上滚落，发出清脆的碰撞声。

    叶凡将这十颗丹药一把推到青衫人面前。

    “换了。”

    话音刚落，他一把抓过那张残缺的羊皮卷，胡乱塞进贴身的衣襟里。

    随后他压低头上的斗笠，转身扎进黑市熙熙攘攘的人流中。

    左拐，右绕。

    叶凡专挑人多且昏暗的巷子走，连续换了三四套外袍，彻底抹除自己身上的气息和痕迹。

    财不外露，这个道理他比谁都懂。

    黑市街尾的一处暗巷。

    青衫人静静站在阴影里，看着叶凡消失的方向，发出一声讥讽的冷笑。

    他抬起手，掌心正托着那十颗散发着浓郁药香的凝气丹。

    这可是底层修士们倾家荡产都想求得的好东西。

    青衫人却连看都没多看一眼。

    他五指微张，随手一抛。

    十颗高品质凝气丹在空中划出一道弧线，扑通几声，全数掉进了满是污水的泥泞坑洼里。

    污水瞬间将药丸吞没，化作一滩烂泥。

    “贪心不足的蝼蚁，也配染指极境。”

    青衫人低声呢喃了一句。

    下一秒，他的身形诡异扭曲，周遭的空气泛起层层涟漪，整个人凭空消散，完全没有留下来过的痕迹。

    天剑宗后山，废阁。

    夜色深沉，废丹房外弥漫着刺鼻的黄绿色毒瘴。

    叶凡一路谨慎，确认身后绝对无人尾随，这才推开那间充满血腥味的破木屋。

    反手将门窗死死拴紧。

    他走到破木桌前，摸出火折子，点亮了一盏微弱的灵油灯。

    昏黄摇曳的光影在逼仄的屋内晃动。

    叶凡深吸一口气，从怀里掏出那张残缺的羊皮卷，小心翼翼的平铺在桌面上。

    羊皮卷质地粗糙，边缘满是烧焦的痕迹，上面密密麻麻写满了蝇头小字。

    叶凡凑到灯前，逐字逐句的研读起来。

    起初，他脸上的表情还带着几分期待和兴奋。

    可随着阅读的深入，他的神色逐渐凝固，两道眉毛拧成了一个死结。

    这功法不对劲！

    根本不是什么正经的修炼法门！

    羊皮卷上记载，修炼这门九龙搬血，需要修炼者主动引动体内的灵气，去焚练骨血。

    什么叫焚练？

    就是把好不容易修来的境界，强行烧退！

    按照功法描述，修炼者需要先正常修炼到锻体九阶，达到巅峰状态。

    然后运转功法，引火烧身，将一身修为直接烧回到锻体一阶！

    这个从九阶跌落回一阶再爬回的过程，被称为一转。

    跌落之后，再重新吸收灵气，一步步爬回锻体九阶，接着再烧！
content_en:
Ye Fan suppressed the heat in his heart caused by the words "Kowloon Moves Blood", without any hesitation, he stretched out his hand directly into his arms.

    He took out the bag containing the medicine and counted ten shimmering Qi Condensing Pills.

    The pills rolled down on the coarse cloth, making a crisp clinking sound.

    Ye Fan pushed the ten pills in front of the man in green shirt.

    "Changed."

    As soon as he finished speaking, he grabbed the incomplete parchment and stuffed it into his close-fitting clothes.

    Then he put down the bamboo hat on his head, turned around and plunged into the bustling crowd of the black market.

    Turn left, go around right.

    Ye Fan chose dark alleys that were crowded with people and changed into three or four sets of robes in succession, completely erasing the scent and traces on his body.

    He understands this principle better than anyone about keeping wealth hidden.

    A dark alley at the end of the black market street.

    The man in green shirt stood quietly in the shadow, looking at the direction where Ye Fan disappeared, and gave a sarcastic sneer.

    He raised his hand, holding the ten Qi Condensing Pills that exuded a strong medicinal fragrance in his palm.

    This is a good thing that the monks at the bottom want to get even if they spend all their money.

    The man in green shirt didn't even look at him.

    He opened his fingers slightly and tossed it casually.

    Ten high-quality Qi Condensing Pills drew an arc in the air, and with a few plops, they all fell into the muddy potholes filled with sewage.

    The sewage instantly swallowed up the pills and turned them into a puddle of mud.

    "A greedy ant is worthy of getting involved in the extreme realm."

    The man in green shirt murmured in a low voice.

    The next second, his figure was twisted strangely, the air around him rippled, and his whole person disappeared out of thin air, leaving no trace of his past.

    In the back mountain of Tianjian Sect, the pavilion was abandoned.

    The night was dark, and a pungent yellow-green poisonous miasma filled the air outside Feidan's room.

    Ye Fan was cautious all the way, making sure that no one was following him, and then pushed away the broken wooden house full of blood.

    Tie the doors and windows tightly with your backhand.

    He walked to the broken wooden table, took out the fire holder, and lit a weak spiritual oil lamp.

    Dim and swaying light and shadow swayed in the cramped room.

    Ye Fan took a deep breath, took out the incomplete parchment roll from his arms, and carefully laid it flat on the table.

    The parchment roll is rough in texture, with burnt marks all over the edges, and is densely covered with tiny writing.

    Ye Fan leaned in front of the lamp and studied it word by word.

    At first, the expression on his face was a bit expectant and excited.

    But as he continued to read, his expression gradually solidified, and his eyebrows twisted into a tight knot.

    There's something wrong with this technique!

    It’s not a serious cultivation method at all!

    It is recorded on the parchment scroll that practicing the Nine Dragons Blood Movement requires the practitioner to actively activate the spiritual energy in the body to burn bones and blood.

    What is Fen Lian?

    It is to forcibly break the state that has been cultivated with great difficulty!

    According to the description of the technique, practitioners need to practice normally to the ninth level of physical exercise to reach the peak state.

    Then run the technique, set fire to the body, and burn the whole body directly back to the first level of body forging!

    This process of falling from the ninth level back to the first level and climbing back again is called a turn.

    After falling, reabsorb the spiritual energy, climb back to the ninth level of body training step by step, and then burn again!
